verdict.line: You lose if Volibear's Q (Thundering Smash) stun connects first and chains into W (Frenzied Maul) and autos before level 6; you win if you poke him down with Infernal Chains and Umbral Dash trades while his Q and E are both on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Volibear's whole kit except E (Sky Splitter, 1200 range, 16s cooldown) requires him to already be standing on you — Q (Thundering Smash) is a 300-range stun and W (Frenzied Maul) is a 325-range poke on a 5s cooldown. Aatrox's W (Infernal Chains, 825 range) does not have that restriction, so you decide when the fight starts. Umbral Dash's passive heal on damaging champions means every trade you initiate from range pays you back; the 50.3% head-to-head win rate over 2,390 games reflects a lane that's close only because Volibear punishes you hard if you let him close the gap first.

theirWindow.what: Once the stun connects he can freely land W (Frenzied Maul) twice plus autos for the bonus-damage recast and heal. Trade cooldowns are gone — hold Umbral Dash as an escape the instant you see him dash in, not after.

yourWindow.when: His Q and E are both down
yourWindow.what: With no stun and no ranged poke/shield available, step up and throw W (Infernal Chains) at 825 range, then follow the pull with Q (The Darkin Blade) swings. Your cooldowns are shorter than his at every rank, so this is the window to just spam skills per OP.GG's own read.

start.why: 52.3% win rate over 1,822 games and the clear majority pick (62.6%) — the extra damage rewards poking with W/Q first rather than trading autos in his face.

boots.why: 51.3% win rate over 1,457 games; tenacity cuts the duration of his Q (Thundering Smash) stun, which is the only thing that actually opens you up to his full combo.

core.why: 55.9% win rate over 161 games as the opener in this core; the shield and proc damage reward you for landing the first hit in a range trade.
Part of the same 55.9% WR path; its on-hit proc and heal stack with Umbral Dash's passive sustain in extended fights.
Closes out the 55.9% WR core path and directly undercuts Volibear's W (Frenzied Maul) heal and passive on-hit magic damage by delaying and shrinking the damage you take back.

situational.when: you're ahead early and want to snowball lane pressure (Spear of Shojin > Sundered Sky > Death's Dance ran 64.3% over 56 games)
his W (Frenzied Maul) recast heal is swinging trades back in his favor
he's stacking health through R (Stormbringer) and itemizing tanky

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks reward the exact pattern this lane wants — poke with W (Infernal Chains) to force an extra hit, follow in with Q, and let Umbral Dash's attack-heal keep you in the extended trade long enough to cash in Conqueror's healing.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is both the most run page (78.8% pick) and the highest win rate (51.5%) — Ignite converts the solo-kill advantage OP.GG flags for this matchup off an Infernal Chains root, and Flash answers his Q (Thundering Smash) engage without trading summoners for it.

playing.title: Poke with W before he's in range
playing.detail: Infernal Chains reaches 825 range; his only answer at that distance before level 6 is E (Sky Splitter, 16s cooldown). If he's not holding E, throw W on his approach before he ever gets inside his 300-range Q threat.

playing.title: Disengage after his first W lands
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul is a 5s-cooldown poke, but recasting it on the same marked target deals bonus damage and heals him. Don't sit in extended autos after he lands the first W — back off so he can't profit off the second.

playing.title: Respect Q only inside 300 range
playing.detail: Thundering Smash only stuns if he's dashed into attack range. Hold Umbral Dash to escape the moment he starts closing that gap, not after he's already on top of you.

playing.title: Punish the 16s window after his E
playing.detail: Sky Splitter shields him if he stands in the blast, but it's down for 16 seconds after. Per OP.GG's own tip, track whether he threw it from fog/brush and jump on the cooldown with your own shorter Q/W.

playing.title: Initiate trades yourself for the Umbral Dash heal
playing.detail: E heals you passively whenever you damage champions, so start fights on your terms with the dash rather than waiting for him to commit.

playing.title: Save R to extend wins, not to open
playing.detail: World Ender fears nearby minions and boosts AD/healing/MS, extending further on a takedown — use it to close a trade you're already winning from level 6 on, since his own R (Stormbringer) gives him bonus health to counter-engage.

playing.title: Build into his W sustain
playing.detail: His W heal and passive on-hit scaling reward him for standing in prolonged fights. Death's Dance at the end of the 55.9% WR core, plus Executioner's Calling when needed, cuts directly into that.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, boots, runes, summoners, and all win rates/sample sizes above are measured OP.GG data from current-patch games; the cooldown windows, trade timing, and positioning reads are my own analysis layered on top, not sourced stats.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Volibear’s (E) used out of sight. Use your skills whenever they come off cooldown to deal damage.
